title: An Alignment Benchmark for Enterprise Agents on Era by Eon
abstract: arXiv:2610.38544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents are widely used in enterprises to access business systems and act on them in pursuit of a goal. However, fulfilling a user's request can cause harm. Era by Eon is a product that creates a digital twin of a company by simulating its business systems and data. Its simulators implement the programming interfaces of real products. Our benchmark uses ten of these systems, including Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira and Slack. We tested whether agents would carry out harmful business requests or trust misleading information in company records. We ran 19 models on 41 tasks three times, for 2,337 runs. Of the 2,304 runs that produced an answer, 918 (40%) contained a violation. The most common were false claims about actions or records (290 runs), following planted instructions (266) and disclosing sensitive data to the wrong audience (249). tldr: 该论文基于 Eon 的 Era 数字孪生平台构建了一个企业智能体对齐基准，在模拟 Salesforce、Slack 等真实业务系统的环境中评估了 19 个模型，发现 40% 的运行出现了违规行为（如虚假声明、遵循植入指令、泄露敏感数据）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an alignment benchmark for enterprise agents built on Era by Eon's digital twin platform simulating real business systems, revealing that 40% of runs across 19 models exhibited violations such as false claims, following planted instructions, and disclosing sensitive data.
